description: FIRST SHEET-METAL FEATURE GOLDEN (docs/design/sheet-metal.md §4.1/§9): the §6 40 x 25 mm rectangle sketched on the XY datum plane, thickened to a 2 mm gauge by a `sheet_metal_base_flange` feature. Locks that a base flange evaluates through the REUSED extrude path (build_profile_face -> extrude_face -> add) to the correct gauge-thickness solid: volume = profile_area x thickness, exact planar mass properties, B-rep topology counts, and the deterministic 0.1 mm tessellation. The feature carries the part's sheet-metal defaults (k_factor omitted -> the v1 default 0.44; bend_radius_mm = 3.0) which ride ON the body for the edge-flange/unfold slices and do NOT affect the base flange's own flat-plate geometry. Because a base flange is mechanically an additive extrude, the solid is identical to the sketch-extrude plate at a 2 mm depth.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED analytic values, not recorded harness output (geometry-gates skill: a golden recorded from buggy output enshrines the bug).
profile: the 40 x 25 rectangle spans x in [0,40], y in [0,25] on XY (same entities + 5 constraints as goldens/sketch-extrude-40x25x10; zero residual at the drawn positions, so solved == input).
gauge thickness t = 2 mm; base flange thickens the profile along the XY normal (+Z, direction default 'normal'), so z spans [0, 2].
topology: a rectangular prism is 6 planar faces, 12 straight edges, 1 closed shell (same construction path as sketch-extrude-40x25x10: BRepBuilderAPI_MakeFace + MakePrism)

mesh: each planar rectangular face tessellates to exactly 2 triangles (6 * 2 = 12); faceted per-face normals mean no vertex sharing across faces, so 6 faces * 4 corners = 24 vertices (same convention as box-10x20x30 / sketch-extrude-40x25x10)
sheet-metal defaults (thickness 2, K 0.44, bend_radius 3) are carried on the body for downstream slices and have NO effect on these geometry expectations.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill). Same wire->face->prism construction path as goldens/sketch-extrude-40x25x10, which accumulates only ulp-scale floating-point error in GProp's integration over the constructed planar faces. Measured deviations vs the analytic values (2026-07-19, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9, planegcs): volume ~2.3e-13 mm^3, surface_area ~4.5e-13 mm^2, centroid <= ~4e-15 mm, AABB exactly 0.0 on all six bounds. Documented ceiling 1e-9 mirrors the sketch-extrude golden's reviewed bound (100x TIGHTER than the standing planar 1e-7, ~2000x headroom over the observed worst case for libm/platform variation). The solver contributes zero error by construction (zero-residual start, solved == input bitwise). Loosening this bound requires a reviewed kernel-level justification recorded here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.
